$comment: Label taxonomy for audio-lab. Convention: 'namespace: value' with a space. Structure follows the github-portfolio-modernization 'goldilocks' set — three axes (type / area / priority), ~14 labels. type and priority are carried verbatim because they are genuinely portable; area values are repo-specific by nature and describe this project's domains. Do not create labels outside this file.

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: Something in the tooling or automation is broken

labels.name: skip-changelog
labels.description: Exempt from the changelog gate — use sparingly
